case.title: Fe3GaTe2, field-driven reversal
case.reason: The only above-room-temperature member of the family, so the only one whose numbers matter for a device that runs on a desk.
case.expectation: Uniaxial, room-temperature-relevant; the cost curve mirrors Fe3GeTe2 scaled by its anisotropy and moment.
case.kill_criterion: A cost curve that does not scale with the anisotropy and moment as the analytic solution predicts would mean the parameter canonicalization is wrong.

material.name: Fe3GaTe2
material.notes: The above-room-temperature member (350 to 380 K, Zhang 2022). Moment and anisotropy are first-principles values (Ruiz 2024); the measured room-temperature anisotropy is lower. Damping assumed and flagged.

moment.note: 2.05 mu_B on Fe1 and Fe2 and 1.35 mu_B on Fe3.

anisotropy.method: DFT magnetic anisotropy energy per Fe
anisotropy.note: Low-temperature first-principles value; the measured room-temperature anisotropy (4.79e5 J/m3, Zhang 2022) is lower.

hard_axis_ratio.note: Modelled as uniaxial: no distinct hard axis enters the macrospin.
